claim: Every remaining zero is a missing control SHAPE, not a missing capability. Repairing a shape converts its whole family from 0.00 to ~1.00 on trials the fix was never tuned on; per-task swings of 0.60 at 5 reps are sampling noise, not decay.

measurement.instrument: full 130 tasks x 5 reps, page-identity enforced per rep, one CDP browser (exclusive)

regression_check.method: every task that moved DOWN was re-measured at 10 reps
regression_check.verdict: NO REGRESSION. Every rerun lands inside the interval between the two measurements. A 0.60 per-task move at 5 reps is 3 trials.

mechanisms_found:
click-collapsible: a jQuery UI accordion wraps EVERY direct child as a header, so the page has the

AND the

holding #subbtn. Clicking 'every collapsed header' opens then closes; the loop ended shut. Read aria-expanded and stop when a panel is open.

click-pie: the wheelnav starts COLLAPSED behind a spreader path (d='M78,78L78,78', zero length) and is STILL ANIMATING when visible (path length 22 -> 135 -> 212). getPointAtLength walks the sector OUTLINE, so elementFromPoint at 50% returns the NEIGHBOURING slice (261/400 sampled points hit-tested to slices 5 and 6). Fix: sweep the SVG bounds with elementFromPoint and take the centroid of the points the PAGE says belong to the slice.

choose-date: #datepicker is readOnly and the page scores an EXACT string compare of its value. The picker opens on a real mouse press, NOT element.click(). The grid opens on a month that is often not the one asked for; other-month cells are ui-state-disabled with no <a>.
instrument_bugs_found: ':visible' is a jQuery extension, not CSS: querySelectorAll(':visible') THROWS, and the probe printed null as if it were a state.
The action string was not truncated because it was empty -- 'expand-all-submit:' is exactly the 18 characters the runner printed. My own printout hid the count.
/tmp/r171_full130.json stores passes under 'passes', not 'ok'. A wrong accessor reported 130/130 zeros including tasks measured at 8/8.
next: Shape census over all 130 pages, repair one family per shape, then a learning-vs-frozen A/B on held-out tasks, which the loop has never run.
